2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch modifies the page_counter_try_charge function to be stock-aware, allowing it to consume stock transparently while preserving existing semantics. It introduces two new parameters: may_batch and nr_charged. The may_batch parameter preserves the behavior of !allow_spinning scenarios, where the goal is to charge as quickly as possible without evicting other stock slots or making a greedy charge to refill the stock. The nr_charged parameter reflects the size of the successful hierarchy charge, preserving existing batch-based memory.high accounting for current->memcg_nr_pages_over_high. This patch preserves existing accounting heuristics and does not introduce any functional changes since no page_counter has stock yet.
